original_text: Routine cine CMR records changing image intensity and anatomy without labels for myocardial material points.
revised_text: Routine cine CMR records anatomy and changing image intensity, not persistent labels for myocardial material points.
tested_scope: cine image information and estimator assumptions
residual_limitation: Texture and temporal cues still constrain correspondence.

original_text: Current evidence most directly supports cine-derived circumferential strain at whole-slice, global and segmental scales.
revised_text: Across the reviewed comparisons, the most consistent positive evidence concerns specified circumferential-strain estimands at whole-slice, global and AHA-segment scales.
residual_limitation: No pooled hierarchy; definitions and populations differ.

original_text: Agreement is weaker for regional than global quantities and weakest for radial strain.
revised_text: Agreement was generally less consistent for regional than global outputs and for radial than circumferential outputs in the cited multivendor and paired studies.
residual_limitation: Not universal across every estimator.

original_text: The one independent test ... preserved slice-averaged circumferential strain better than radial strain.
revised_text: The only prescribed-focal test identified in the recorded search reported smaller slice-averaged circumferential than radial error, without scar-region error.
tested_scope: four generated cases; three mid-ventricular slices
residual_limitation: Different components and error scales; no focal recovery endpoint.

original_text: Global measures can hide regional dysfunction.
revised_text: Global averaging can conceal compensating or spatially opposing regional changes.
residual_limitation: Does not quantify prevalence or clinical effect.

original_text: Clinical associations justify the measurement.
revised_text: Clinical associations establish biological or prognostic relevance for the studied endpoint; they do not by themselves validate localisation or motion accuracy.
residual_limitation: Central association sources not all freshly re-read.

original_text: Primary studies on which principal conclusions rest were read in full; ledger states depth for every cited source.
revised_text: The supplied ledger records depth for 69 cited keys; central quantitative sources were rechecked for this revision, while other sources retain their recorded depth.
residual_limitation: Historical full-text files absent; human verification pending.

original_text: Equal contours do not determine material correspondence.
revised_text: Identical boundary masks can correspond to different internal material maps and circumferential stretch fields.
residual_limitation: Shows non-uniqueness, not that any estimator is wrong.

original_text: A complete strain estimand requires reference, measure, axes, layer, dimensionality, differentiation, region, timing and aggregation.
revised_text: Comparisons should specify these choices when they can change the reported quantity.
residual_limitation: Exact minimum reporting set depends on intended use.

original_text: The data term alone does not identify the map and the prior selects among candidates.
revised_text: Where image evidence is insufficient to distinguish candidate maps, representation and regularisation influence the selected correspondence.
residual_limitation: Not every location or acquisition is equally underdetermined.

original_text: Material-sensitive references appear in 14 of 48 entries; one prescribed focal test.
revised_text: The authors' classification of 48 reviewed entries assigns 14 to material-sensitive/known-motion evidence and one to a prescribed focal test.
source_key_doi_url: Supplementary Table S3 and figure data
residual_limitation: Not a prevalence estimate; several rows are abstract-level.

original_text: Remote/scar strains show radial and circumferential strain largely abolished.
revised_text: In the generated infarct case, peak radial strain changed from 0.95 to 0.30 and circumferential strain from −0.18 to 0.01; longitudinal strain changed from −0.18 to −0.17.
residual_limitation: Simulation-specific strain convention.

original_text: DeepStrain error 1.0±0.9 mm; Ecc 0.02±0.04; radial −0.24±0.21.
revised_text: Same values, explicitly labelled averages across generated cases/three mid-ventricular slices.
residual_limitation: No scar-region error or between-case inference.

original_text: Per-case SDs overlap, so ordering rests on panels.
revised_text: No between-case inferential comparison was reported; the descriptive means and SDs do not establish a case ranking.
residual_limitation: Source qualitatively calls infarct case lowest performance.

original_text: Paired tagging/DENSE evidence is direction- and product-specific.
revised_text: Paired evidence supports selected component-, layer-, slice- and product-specific comparisons, not a general cine-versus-DENSE verdict.
residual_limitation: References carry their own processing error.

original_text: Cine statistically equivalent to two-slice DENSE for endocardial Ecc within 3.5%.
revised_text: In 40 healthy volunteers, the cine model met TOST equivalence within a selected ±3.5-point margin (mean difference −2.7 points) despite a significant paired difference and d=−0.89.
residual_limitation: No disease or focal test; repeated slices.

original_text: StrainNet EPE and cine Ecc results.
revised_text: DENSE-contour EPE and cine-contour Ecc comparisons are reported as separate tests.
residual_limitation: No external set; no radial strain.

original_text: LGE AUCs rank DENSE, tagging and FT.
revised_text: AUCs quantify discrimination of >50% transmural LGE segments in that cohort, not material-motion accuracy.
residual_limitation: Segment dependence and threshold-specific endpoint.

original_text: Repeatability establishes precision, not accuracy.
revised_text: Same.
residual_limitation: No pathological or long-term repeatability inference.

original_text: Three-stage validation programme.
revised_text: A proposed claim-matched programme progresses from known motion to paired material-sensitive acquisition and downstream relevance; not every paper must implement every stage.
residual_limitation: Not validated by this review.

original_text: Current evidence most directly supports circumferential strain.
revised_text: The reviewed set contains its most consistent positive comparisons for specified circumferential estimands.
residual_limitation: No formal evidence grading or meta-analysis.

original_text: Direct focal centroid/boundary/extent tests were uncommon or not reported.
revised_text: Within the recorded search and reviewed sources, direct focal centroid, boundary and extent errors were rarely reported.
source_locator: bounded search log and table review
residual_limitation: Cannot establish universal absence.

original_text: Focal peak-time error remains untested.
revised_text: No focal peak-time error against a material-sensitive reference was identified in the recorded search.
residual_limitation: A study may exist outside the search.

original_text: Combining resources can identify recoverability conditions.
revised_text: Combining complementary resources is a proposed route to testing conditional recoverability.
